title: First voice download after high school: 'reality is subjective'

tellings.quote: The first one that I ever got was I was just out of high school and it didn't make any sense to me, which is was the voice was reality is subjective.

plain: A man named Brent, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that just after he finished high school he heard a voice in his head for the first time. He says the message was "reality is subjective," and that it made no sense to him then. He tells it as the first of several such messages, which would mean something outside him was speaking to him.
